note: PUBLIC-SAFE EXAMPLE. The real seed lives at <control_root>/context-read/shared_terms.seed.v0.json and is Owner-placed; the terms below are placeholders and the project codes are not real ones. The seed declares a term shared before the graph has shown it in two projects — it never removes a term, and it never invents evidence: `projects` is where the term was actually seen, so a row without at least one project code is refused. The generated registry (<control_root>/context-read/shared_terms.v0.json) is derived from this file plus the graph index and may be regenerated at any time.

terms.note: 어디에서 봤는지 한 줄. 예: 두 과제의 회의 기록과 메일 제목에 같은 형태로 나옴.
약어는 대소문자를 구분하지 않고 찾으며, 붙어 있는 한글 조사는 그대로 허용한다.
